messages:
incident-bot: Alert: spike in OOMs on cluster-prod-gpu-5 starting 2026-03-14T22:15Z. 25 OOMs in 10m, container restarts detected, node flaps on gpu-5 and gpu-7.
carol.oncall: Saw the alert. Currently correlating with recent deploy of paged-attn allocator v2.3.0. Reproducing logs now.
ben.runtime: I'm on it, attaching logs from gpu-5:
```
[2026-03-14T22:12:03Z] CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 64MB
[2026-03-14T22:12:03Z] pid=4321 runtime: kv_cache_reserve failed: slab_frag: 98% used
[2026-03-14T22:12:03Z] container crash (exit 137)
```
carol.oncall: Metrics: token throughput steady, but kv_cache.size has linear climb over last 72h on a subset of pods. Paging ratio (attn_paged/page_faults per min) up x3. Suspect slow leak w/ paged allocator fragmentation.
eng-runtime-lead: Oncall, this matches a regression we saw internally in allocator's compaction path when mixed small/big sequences present. It leaks page metadata; fragmentation accumulates -> OOM over days.
dmitri.sre: Customer impact: 3 services affected (chat, embeddings), ~2.1% 503s in last 30m (~420 requests). One enterprise tenant reported degraded latency. Not widespread yet but rising.
carol.oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) cordon gpu-5 and schedule rolling restart of affected pods 2) toggle runtime env REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION_COMPACT_FREQ=1 (enable aggressive compaction) 3) enable kv_eviction=true on heavy pods.
ben.runtime: Applying REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION_COMPACT_FREQ=1 to canary group now. Patching deploy via:
```
kubectl set env deploy/runtime-canary REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION_COMPACT_FREQ=1
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-canary
```
ben.runtime: Canary restarted, monitoring logs.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollout started for runtime-canary at 2026-03-14T22:25Z.
ben.runtime: After restart, immediate drop in page_faults/min on canary from 120 -> 18. No new OOMs for canary pods in 7m.
carol.oncall: Good. Plan: continue canary for 15m, if stable promote to 50% and start draining gpu-5/gpu-7 nodes.
eng-runtime-lead: Also pushing a hotfix branch that patches allocator compaction bug (misaligned bitmap clearance). If canary holds, we should roll hotfix to stable later tonight. PR#2147.
dmitri.sre: Noted, beginning node drains for gpu-5 and gpu-7. ETA to fully drain 12m.
carol.oncall: Handoff note for next oncall: if OOMs persist after compaction env toggle, escalate to eng-runtime and consider rolling back paged-attn allocator v2.3.0 to v2.2.5. Also prepare to enable automatic fallback route that maps requests to non-paged model variants (higher cost but safer).
ben.runtime: Adding temporary route rule: /v1/generate -> model-variant: no-paged-fallback for heavy tenants. Will apply to the 3 affected services only.
carol.oncall: Customer comms draft: "We're investigating increased memory pressure for some inferences causing intermittent 5xx responses; we've applied mitigations and expect stabilization within 45 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause and permanent fix." Approve?
dmitri.sre: +1
eng-runtime-lead: +1, add note about hotfix PR link.
carol.oncall: Rolling to 50% now.
incident-bot: Rollout bot: runtime-canary -> runtime-stable 50% at 2026-03-14T22:40Z.
ben.runtime: Stable at 50% shows steady metrics, kv_cache.size growth halted on updated pods. Node drains complete for gpu-5, gpu-7. Recovered pods on other nodes.
carol.oncall: Customer impact update: 503 rate down to 0.4% last 10m. One tenant still sees occasional latency spikes; investigating their request patterns.
eng-runtime-lead: Root cause hypothesis: compaction path skipped on mixed allocation sizes due to a bitmap alignment bug; small allocation churn left stale page headers leading to fragmentation. Fix in PR#2147 updates bitmap clear and adds unit/regression test.
ben.runtime: Preparing rollback plan to v2.2.5 if we see reversion. For now keep compaction env and monitor for 1h. I'll update runbook with commands used.
carol.oncall: Handoff for next shift @ben.runtime. Please monitor kv_cache.size, page_faults/min, OOM count, and customer tickets. Escalate if OOMs > 3 in 30m.
ben.runtime: Taking handoff. I'll also coordinate postmortem writeup and RCA once hotfix merges.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paged-attn-frag
carol.oncall: Closing active mitigation stage. Will open ticket INC-2026-431 for follow-up tasks: hotfix rollout, long-term telemetry for fragmentation, and backlog item to add eviction heuristics.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, mitigations=env_compaction_toggle,node_drains,fallback_route, time=2026-03-14T23:05Z.
carol.oncall: Thanks team. If anything flares, re-open thread. :thumbsup:
ben.runtime: Copy. I'll ping logs/metrics in 30m and then hand off.
